g.text: MarieRank4Convo3 begins.
How are you today, Marie?
[End.]
I am not so grand. You may wish to come back to talk to me tomorrow. I will not be the best of company.
Chat ends.
I'll go if you want, but if you want to talk, I'm happy to listen.
All right, I understand.
May I ask what's wrong...?
C'est vraiment gentil, but it is an old problem... nothing worth troubling yourself over. I will be fine.
Chat ends.
Update boolean MarieChronicPain
If you're certain, but I'm here, if you want to talk about it.

I... know what that's like. Before I started "looping," I hurt myself pretty badly in Duviri. It healed, but it still aches something awful from time to time. I try to hide my wincing when it acts up.
Old persistent problems can sometimes be as problematic as new ones. Just because they come and go, and can stay with us, doesn't mean they aren't worth talking about.
You are so very kind, and... very well. I am being little stubborn Marie again.
Update boolean DrifterChronicPain
Oui, tu as raison. I am being little stubborn Marie again.
It is a hard thing to explain, but I will try. Mes pieds, oui ? My feet. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -
Par les Luminaires, I am so very sorry. You understand then, what it is like, oui ?
But I still feel them, those twisted things that threatened to consume me, threatened to crush all hope and joie from my soul.
To have a body that betrays you, that slows your spirit down. Even now, it is so strange. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -
Always they hurt. Always. Even now, as I sit here, if I think of them, I feel the pain. But it is not always enough that I notice.
Still, now, they wake me wake in the night from aching. And I wonder, Sol, pourquoi ? Why must I still feel this... agonie interminable ?
What purpose does it serve ? Ah, but then the morning comes, and I laugh, and tell myself, "be quiet, Marie, you are blessed. Look at all you have, all that you can do."

At the Cathédrale it was "You can read, you can write, you can eat, you can sleep. You can move about well enough. You have eyes to see and a tongue to speak. Hands with which to write. Those who care for you." And now, I can fly! I can protect the futur from the Void itself. From l'Indifférence !
"Weep now, silly girl, this constant pain will make you strong against what will come," I tell myself. And the day moves into another and it is not as bad when the next one comes.
Check boolean DrifterChronicPain
If there's one thing it's given us, it's a tolerance for pain, I suppose.
true
Sometimes, though... I wake up and I feel like it's going to be the day that I break.
true
It... really never stops hurting? I'm so, so sorry, Marie...
false
And there's no medication? No treatment?
false
A parishioner once asked me, "you are in pain? Always?" To which I replied, "Oui, monsieur. Je le suis." His look of astonishment was mixed with horror.
Sometimes, I used to sit and think of how much I could do if I were not in so much agonie, oui ? If I were not so... trapped in a cage of flesh that was so set upon hindering me at every turn.
Would I wish there was. Mais non, there is not. Not in my time, and I fear likely not in this one.
"How do you go on?" was his next question. And I remember I smiled to him and replied "What is my other choice, Monsieur...?"

How furious it would make me ! How jealous I would become of those whose bodies were not born a betrayal to them. But what good does it do us in the end, à part rendre nos vies plus amères ? More embittered ?
Some ailments are beyond the cures of man, science, and faith.
I have had that same conversation so many times...
Exactly. I'm so sorry.
Aucun. I am how I am, and I shall persevere.
Non, I am simply sorry you have shared in such a similar agonie.
Check boolean DrifterChronicPain
And so shall you. So shall you. In this, I have faith.
true
+20 Chemistry
false
I cannot put into words how much this conversation has meant to me. So I will simply say merci, Drifter.
Et encore merci.
Chat ends.
